proposals.evidence: DEDR3758 explicitly gives Malayalam innalē yesterday within the nerunal family. Survey innale/innala/indale/indala/inale preserves that southern yesterday formation with source medial consonant and vowel variants retained. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3758 explicitly gives Irula nagaṯṯu/næṯṯu yesterday and Kota nēr (oblique nēṯ-), beside Tamil nerunal. These nēṯṯ-/nagaṯṯ-/nēṟ- survey forms retain that yesterday family and its documented medial/oblique variants; source transcription remains unchanged. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3805 gives Tamil/Malayalam pakal and Kannada pagal daytime, with Gondi piyal noon. These pakal/pahalu/pagal/agalu survey noon responses use the daylight noun for the middle of the day, preserving the source noon gloss and ordinary p/h/zero and final-vowel notation. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3263(a) documents tiṉ/tinn- eat, with Tamil past tiṉṟ-, Kannada tind-, Kodagu timb-/tind-, Kota/Toda tiḏ- and Gadaba tin-/tiy-/tinḍ-. Selected simple and ordinary tense/nominal forms retain that eat stem and its documented alternants; survey endings, voicing and vowels are preserved. Longer auxiliary/pronoun clauses and uncertain rounded-vowel forms are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1654 documents kuṭi drink and the southern past-stem kuḍic-. Selected kuḍic-/kuḍicc- survey past forms retain that stem with ordinary person/tense endings and source syllable marks unchanged. The paired eat/drink elicitation labels are preserved; s-forms with possible causative ambiguity are not included here. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
